import time

def _t():

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.t = time.time()
    times = [time.monotonic() for n in range(100)]
    t1 = times[0]
    for t2 in times[1:]:
        assert t2 >= t1, ('assertGreaterEqual', t2, t1)
        t1 = t2
    t1 = time.monotonic()
    time.sleep(0.5)
    t2 = time.monotonic()
    dt = t2 - t1
    assert t2 > t1, ('assertGreater', t2, t1)
    assert 0.45 <= dt, ('assertTrue', 0.45 <= dt)
    info = time.get_clock_info('monotonic')
    assert info.monotonic, ('assertTrue', info.monotonic)
    assert not info.adjustable, ('assertFalse', info.adjustable)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
